challenge.scenario: A non-owner member attempts to transfer group ownership to another participant.
challenge.finding: Could steal owner role through service-role RPC if owner predicate ineffective.

challenge.scenario: Current owner selects themselves as the new owner.
challenge.finding: Could log meaningless transfer and mask missing target guard.

challenge.scenario: Current owner selects an account not participating in the group.
challenge.finding: Cross-thread privilege escalation or ownerless state.

challenge.scenario: A target exists in another tenant store, not this group.
challenge.resolution: Create two real store fixtures; transfer must reject target with exact same-thread membership condition.

challenge.scenario: An actor supplies thread id from second tenant but instance id from first.
challenge.finding: Could authorize different tenant via mismatched parameter.

challenge.scenario: Valid transfer demotes source but target promotion fails.
challenge.finding: Group could become ownerless or have two owners.
challenge.resolution: In one transaction, assert single owner, demoted source, and target owner; rollback on any exception.

challenge.scenario: Ownership transfer succeeds without audit log.
challenge.finding: No accountable record of private group governance.
challenge.resolution: Check admin_audit_log typed event, instance/thread metadata after transfer.

challenge.scenario: New owner cannot transfer authority back.
challenge.finding: Owner lifecycle not reversible or reads stale old owner state.
challenge.resolution: Perform valid transfer back, assert original owner restored and sole-owner count.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Team Chat 2 owner transfer 0067 and integrity 0066 are already installed and basic privilege negative probes PASS on isolated PostgreSQL 18, but no actual authorized owner transfer or cross-tenant/forged actor rejection is tested. Extend only the existing local socket-only PG18 Fresh Install rehearsal with a rollback-only fixture that provisions disposable users, two tenant organizations/instances, scoped support role_bindings, an internal group thread and active owner/member participants; prove positive owner transfer, resulting sole owner and audit, self-transfer/nonowner/nonparticipant/cross-tenant rejection and reversible owner transfer. Preserve canonical 69 SQL migrations and pending managed Supabase/JWT/Pro acceptance.
observableOutcomes: All current 69 Fresh Install migrations still run on disposable PostgreSQL 18 with official preflight/auth/seed/postflight.
One rollback-only fixture creates two isolated test store identities and role-bound group participants; checks current owner and new member read permissions before transfer.
Real service-role-only owner RPC transfers active owner to member, verifies single owner, demoted source, audit and second transfer back.
Invalid self-transfer, non-owner, unknown target and cross-instance target are rejected with exact canonical error codes, not arbitrary failure.
Existing Team Chat RLS/catalog/mention negatives and Office email/reply proofs remain PASS; fixture data entirely rolled back.
Tests and Control Plane quality-infra risk 2/5 pass; native provider Auth/JWT, concurrency and Pro downgrade remain open.
